import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 210;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAX*MAX*2][MAX*MAX*2];
    static int[][] f = new int[MAX*MAX*2][MAX*MAX*2];
    static int[] level = new int[MAX*MAX*2];
    static int[] count_level = new int[MAX*MAX*2];
    static int n, t, src, dst;
    
    static int id(int r, int c) { return (r-1)*n + c; }
    static boolean ok(int r, int c) { return r>=1 && r<=n && c>=1 && c<=n; }
    
    static void link(int u, int v, int c) { cap[u][v] += c; }
    
    static int dfs(int u, int lim) {
        if (u == dst) return lim;
        int pushed = lim, delta, min_level = n*n*2+2;
        for (int v = 0; v < n*n*2+2; ++v) {
            if (cap[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0) {
                if (level[u] == level[v] + 1) {
                    delta = dfs(v, Math.min(pushed, cap[u][v] - f[u][v]));
                    f[u][v] += delta;
                    f[v][u] -= delta;
                    pushed -= delta;
                    if (level[src] == n*n*2+2 || pushed == 0) return lim - pushed;
                }
                min_level = Math.min(min_level, level[v] + 1);
            }
        }
        if (pushed == lim) {
            count_level[level[u]]--;
            count_level[min_level]++;
            if (count_level[level[u]] == 0) level[src] = n*n*2+2;
            level[u] = min_level;
        }
        return lim - pushed;
    }
    
    static int max_flow() {
        if (src == dst) return INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < n*n*2+2; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n*n*2+2; ++j) {
                f[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        Arrays.fill(level, 0);
        Arrays.fill(count_level, 0);
        int res = 0;
        while (level[src] < n*n*2+2) {
            res += dfs(src, INF);
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static class Pos {
        int r, c, d;
        Pos(int r, int c, int d) { this.r = r; this.c = c; this.d = d; }
    }
    
    static int[][] dist = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] mat1 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] mat2 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int sx, sy;
    static final int[] dr = {0,0,-1,1};
    static final int[] dc = {-1,1,0,0};
    
    static void precompute() {
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Pos(sx, sy, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX; ++j) {
                dist[i][j] = 0x7f7f7f7f;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], false);
        }
        vis[sx][sy] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            dist[cur.r][cur.c] = cur.d;
            if (cur.d > t) break;
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nr = cur.r + dr[k], nc = cur.c + dc[k];
                if (ok(nr,nc) && mat1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                    Pos nxt = new Pos(nr, nc, cur.d+1);
                    vis[nr][nc] = true;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void search_from(int r, int c) {
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Pos(r, c, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], false);
        }
        vis[r][c] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (cur.d > t) break;
            if (dist[cur.r][cur.c] < cur.d) continue;
            if (dist[cur.r][cur.c] == cur.d && (mat2[cur.r][cur.c] < '1' || mat2[cur.r][cur.c] > '9')) continue;
            if (mat2[cur.r][cur.c] >= '1' && mat2[cur.r][cur.c] <= '9') {
                if (cur.r != r || cur.c != c) {
                    link(id(r,c), id(cur.r,cur.c) + n*n, INF);
                }
                if (dist[cur.r][cur.c] == cur.d) continue;
            }
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nr = cur.r + dr[k], nc = cur.c + dc[k];
                if (ok(nr,nc) && mat1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                    Pos nxt = new Pos(nr, nc, cur.d+1);
                    vis[nr][nc] = true;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            mat1[i] = new char[MAX];
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                mat1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            mat2[i] = new char[MAX];
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                mat2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        src = 0; dst = 2*n*n+1;
        
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                if (mat1[i][j]>='1' && mat1[i][j]<='9') {
                    link(src, id(i,j), mat1[i][j]-'0');
                }
                if (mat1[i][j]=='Z') { sx=i; sy=j; }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                link(id(i,j), id(i,j)+n*n, INF);
                if (mat2[i][j]>='1' && mat2[i][j]<='9') {
                    link(id(i,j)+n*n, dst, mat2[i][j]-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        precompute();
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                if (mat1[i][j]>='1' && mat1[i][j]<='9') {
                    search_from(i,j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
